newsitem.title: USA: Clinton meets president of Eritrea.
newsitem.headline: Clinton meets president of Eritrea.

text.p: President Bill Clinton met on Thursday with President Isayas Afewerki of Eritrea and discussed efforts to stabilise Central Africa, the White House said.
Clinton and Vice President Al Gore participated briefly in a meeting Isayas had at the White House with national security adviser Anthony Lake.

"The leaders discussed the crisis in Central Africa, options for bringing increased stability to the region, particularly Zaire, the the situation in Sudan," Press Secretary Mike McCurry said in a statement.
"President Clinton congratulated President Isayas for the exceptional progress Eritrea has made in reforming its economy and attracting foreign investment," McCurry said.
